Before ordering, re-read the current TE revision for the three facts this repo depends on (insulation category, terminal assignment, open-contact capacitance). why_this_file: ADR-084 makes the Stax mute relay K3 a relay whose coil-to-contact insulation does not count as a credible single failure; ADR-085 (L60c2, the user's 'Accetta il supplementare' and 'TE Axicom IM06TS') accepts SUPPLEMENTARY insulation declared by the maker. This datasheet is where that declaration, the pin map and the figures ADR-044 compares are read.

what_was_read.insulation_category: p. 3 (Features block, right column): 'Insulation Category: Supplementary insulation according IEC / EN 60950; Working voltage <= 300 Vrms; Mains supply voltage <= 250 Vrms; Repetitive peak voltage 2500 V; Pollution degree internal 1, external 2'.
what_was_read.insulation_figures: p. 22, Insulation, standard version: dielectric test (1 min) coil-contacts 1800 Vrms, adjacent contact sets 1000 Vrms, open contacts 1000 Vrms; surge 2500 V coil-contacts (Telcordia 2/10 us and IEC 60950 10/700 us); insulation resistance > 1e9 ohm at 500 Vdc.
what_was_read.coil: p. 6, coil versions, 140 mW standard: 12 V nominal, operate 9.00 V, max 28.90 V, release 1.20 V, 140 mW, 1029 ohm; IM06TS = 2-1462037-7 (SMT J-legs), IM06GR = 2-1462037-3 (THT standard). 12 V / 1029 ohm = 11.7 mA.
what_was_read.contacts: p. 20: 2 changeover, bifurcated, palladium-ruthenium gold-covered; initial contact resistance < 50 mohm (10 mA / 20 mV); minimum switching voltage 100 uV; thermoelectric potential < 10 uV.
what_was_read.capacitance_and_rf: p. 23, High Frequency Data, IM: capacitance coil-contacts max 2 pF, adjacent contact sets max 2 pF, OPEN CONTACTS MAX 1 pF; isolation -37.0 dB at 100 MHz, -18.8 dB at 900 MHz (50 ohm).
what_was_read.timing: p. 23, General Data: operate time typ 1 ms / max 3 ms; release time without diode typ 1 / max 3 ms, with diode in parallel typ 3 / max 5 ms; bounce at closing typ 1 / max 5 ms. No transfer time is published.
what_was_read.terminal_assignment: p. 5, 'Terminal Assignment, Relay - top view, Non-Latching Type, not energized condition': coil + on pin 1, - on pin 8 (POLARISED); pole 1 COM 3 resting on 2, open to 4; pole 2 COM 6 resting on 7, open to 5. Read on three legs that agree, in L60c2: the rendered page (450 dpi crop); the SVG vector coordinates (docs/preamp/data/2026-10-15/L60c2/script/im_pinmap_svg.py: at the contact-tip height the armature crosses the 2 / 7 contact segment at x = 100.9 pt, inside its 96.2-104.0 pt span, and stops 9.8 pt short of the 4 / 5 segment, on both poles); the polylines of the KiCad symbol Relay:IM00, where the armature tip's x is EXACTLY the 2 / 7 contact's x (-1.905 / 8.255 mm). Same map as the G6K-2F-Y.
what_was_read.pad_layout: p. 5, Solder Pad Layout, SMT J-legs: pins 1-4 bottom row, 8-5 top row, 2.2 mm pitch, 3.2 mm from the coil pin; the KiCad footprint Relay_SMD:Relay_DPDT_AXICOM_IMSeries_JLeg numbers its pads 1-8 the same way, rotated 90 degrees: 1-4 at x = -2.2 mm, 8-5 at x = +2.2 mm, spacing 3.2 / 2.2 / 2.2 mm along y.
